narration.text: Imagine describing a wild idea and watching it become a full illustrated comic, panel by panel.
Until now, no AI agent could actually turn your story into a complete comic with art and dialogue.
Meet BoredComic: it writes the storyboard, generates every panel, and delivers a ready-to-read comic.
You describe the scenario, genre, and characters, and BoredComic creates multi-page artwork with consistent characters.
For fifty cents you get one to five pages; one dollar gives six to ten; three dollars yields eleven to twenty.
Try BoredComic today on OKX dot AI — turn any story into a real comic.
